established_memories.guidance: When searching for toiletries (soap, toothpaste, etc.) in bathroom environments, prioritize inspecting open surfaces like countertops and sink basins before checking closed storage units (cabinets, drawers). This semantic prioritization often yields faster acquisition than arbitrary spatial ordering or exhaustive type grouping.
